description:
You are a Library Technician standardizing the Chinook music database to comply with your university's data governance policy, which requires all database objects to use lowercase_snake_case naming.

Open the SQL editor in LibreOffice Base (Tools > SQL...) and execute the following 7 rename operations using double-quoted identifiers to preserve lowercase:

Table Renames (2):
1. ALTER TABLE "InvoiceLine" RENAME TO "invoice_line"
2. ALTER TABLE "PlaylistTrack" RENAME TO "playlist_track"

Column Renames (5):
3. ALTER TABLE "Genre" ALTER COLUMN "Name" RENAME TO "genre_name"
4. ALTER TABLE "MediaType" ALTER COLUMN "Name" RENAME TO "type_name"
5. ALTER TABLE "Artist" ALTER COLUMN "Name" RENAME TO "artist_name"
6. ALTER TABLE "Playlist" ALTER COLUMN "Name" RENAME TO "playlist_name"
7. ALTER TABLE "Album" ALTER COLUMN "Title" RENAME TO "album_title"

After executing all statements, save the database file using Ctrl+S.

IMPORTANT: Use double-quoted identifiers exactly as shown to preserve lowercase names. All existing data must remain intact. The database file is /home/ga/chinook.odb.
